sources.title: Aishell1Mix: Towards Robust Mandarin Speech Separation with Scalable ...
sources.snippet: The cocktail party problem remains a fundamental challenge in single-channel speech separation. Models trained on English datasets (WSJ0-2Mix, LibriMix) perform well in-domain but often fail to generalize to Mandarin. We address this gap with Aishell1Mix, the first open-source Mandarin separation dataset, constructed by mixing AISHELL-1 utterances and optionally adding WHAM!-style noise. In ...
